projects.title: Sound of Humanity
projects.desc: A real-time audio-reactive visualization of human voices from around the world. WebGL fragment shaders pulse with the rhythm of submitted recordings.

projects.title: Electoral Map
projects.desc: Interactive U.S. electoral map with county-level drill-down, historical comparisons, and demographic overlays. Built with D3 + TopoJSON.

image.alt: Electoral Map — election timeline, vote charts and state tiles

projects.title: BLUEbikes Availability
projects.desc: Live bike-share station availability across Greater Boston. Auto-refreshing station map with predictive availability based on time-of-day patterns.

projects.title: 3D Asset Editor
projects.desc: Browser-based mesh editor with collision authoring, Gaussian Splatting support, and direct export to glTF. React Three Fiber + zustand.

image.alt: 3D Asset Editor — editable cube and transform controls

projects.title: MeshBVH X-Ray
projects.desc: Cross-section viewer for massive 3D meshes using BVH-accelerated raycasting. Slices through millions of triangles in real time.

image.alt: MeshBVH X-Ray — LittlestTokyo model with BVH wireframe and slice controls

projects.title: Procedural Sky Lab
projects.desc: A WebGL playground for physically-based atmospheric scattering. Real-time control over Rayleigh / Mie coefficients with HDR capture.

projects.title: Type Specimen
projects.desc: An interactive typography specimen book covering 12 contemporary typefaces, with variable-axis sliders and a live rendering canvas.

projects.title: Vintage Web Archive
projects.desc: A nostalgic walk through hand-crafted websites of the early web. Editorial layout, full-bleed photography, and slow-scroll storytelling.
